name: ProgressTracker
purpose: Show where someone is in a linear, multi-step journey with named steps.
intent: A segmented, labelled progress bar that fills to the current step and marks it as the active position.

parts.items: code-parts / <items> (node 2184:38493): the per-step segment, with size (md|lg) x isActive x hasVisited x isDisabled x state (default|hover|focus) x section (start|middle|end). section drives the outer-corner rounding; isActive/hasVisited drive the navy fill and its trailing rounded cap; the label is the `link` atom (appearance=subtle, size=md in both sizes).

figmaSource.notes: The Figma component is built from per-step segments with per-edge borders (start=top/bottom/left, middle=top/bottom, end=top/bottom/right) so adjacent segments read as one continuous pill. In code this is a single track + single fill (width = currentStep / totalSteps); the fill's own full-round radius reproduces the rounded leading + trailing caps. Only visited (past) steps are interactive in Figma (hover/focus states exist only for isActive=false, hasVisited=true) - mirrored in code by rendering only visited steps with an href as links.

useCases: a multi-step form or checkout with named steps
any linear sequence where step names and position both matter
antiPatterns: relative position without labels (use Progress Indicator dots)

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: the full-round pill (sunken surface, border/bold), carries the fill; data-fill is the fill percentage

anatomy.name: fill
anatomy.description: the brand/primary/bold portion, currentStep / totalSteps wide, full-round caps

anatomy.name: steps
anatomy.description: the ordered list of step labels

anatomy.name: step
anatomy.description: one step; the label is a Link (visited + href) or a span (current/upcoming/disabled)

disabled.description: mutes labels, greys the fill, switches the track border to the disabled token, removes links

accessibility.navigableSteps: visited steps with an href render as the Link atom, restyled to the <items> states (no :visited colour; hover changes colour only, no underline)

keyboardInteraction: Visited step links use native anchor behavior and the shared Focus Ring.
behaviorRules: Render one step per steps[] entry, in order, inside an ordered list.
Clamp currentStep to the one-based range 1..steps.length.
Fill the track to currentStep / totalSteps.
Mark the current step with aria-current="step"; it is never a link.
Render a step as a Link only when it is visited (before current), has an href, and is not disabled.
Restyle the visited-step Link to the <items> states: no :visited (purple) colour; hover changes colour only (content/subtle -> content/default) with no underline.
disabled greys the fill, switches the track border to border/disabled, mutes every label, and removes all links.
Two sizes change only the bar thickness; labels stay heading-xs.
compositionRules: Give the tracker an accessible name.
Provide hrefs on visited steps to allow jumping back.
The per-step segment ('items') stays private anatomy; do not export it.
contentRules: Keep the step count small enough that the bar segments stay legible.
responsiveRules: The tracker fills its container width; segments and labels share the width equally.
Labels are centred under each step.
themeRules: Do not reference primitive colors directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: React and TypeScript; React.forwardRef on the root nav.
CSS Modules and the shared Focus Ring (via the Link atom).
Compose the Link atom for navigable step labels.
Single track + single fill; the fill width is a CSS custom property, not per-segment nodes.
No MUI, no Tailwind, no hardcoded colors/typography/spacing.
do: Use for a linear journey with named steps.
Give the tracker an accessible name.
Link the visited steps so people can go back.
Use lg for more prominent surfaces.
dont: Use for label-less relative position (use Progress Indicator).
Use for determinate percentage (use Progress Bar).
Make the current or upcoming steps links.
Expose the per-step segment part publicly.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a labelled nav with an ordered list of steps.
Marks the current step with aria-current="step".
Renders visited steps with an href as links; current and upcoming steps are not links.
Clamps currentStep and sets the fill to currentStep / totalSteps.
disabled greys the fill, switches the track border to border/disabled, and removes links.
A single disabled step is not a link even when visited with an href.
Visited-step Link is restyled: no :visited colour; hover changes colour only, no underline.
Applies the size on the root.
Does not use MUI or Tailwind.
